6	import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
7	import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Maps
8	import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.MonoidAlgebra
9	import Mathlib.RingTheory.PolynomialAlgebra
10	import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.MapDomain

12	/-!
13	# Base change for polynomial and Laurent polynomial rings
14	
15	For a commutative ring `k` and a `k`-algebra `A` we record the canonical algebra
16	equivalences
17	
18	* `polyBaseChange`   : `k[X] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[X]`,
19	* `laurentBaseChange`: `k[T;T⁻¹] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]`,
20	
21	and compute their effect on the tensors `x ⊗ₜ 1`.  On such elements each equivalence
22	is the coefficient-change ring homomorphism induced by `algebraMap k A`: for
23	polynomials this is `Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A)`, and for Laurent polynomials it
24	is `AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)` (there is no dedicated
25	`LaurentPolynomial.map` in mathlib).
26	
27	The final two lemmas are the payload consumed by the scheme-level `ℙ¹` bridge: the two
28	`ℙ¹` chart maps `Polynomial.toLaurent` (`X ↦ T 1`) and
29	`Polynomial.eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))` (`X ↦ T (-1)`) intertwine base change with the
30	polynomial coefficient map.  These are pure commutative algebra.
31	-/
32	
33	set_option autoImplicit false
34	
35	universe u
36	
37	open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial TensorProduct
38	
39	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
40	
41	variable {k A : Type u} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
42	
43	/-- Base change for the polynomial ring: `k[X] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[X]`. -/
44	noncomputable def polyBaseChange (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
45	    (Polynomial k) ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial A :=
46	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k (Polynomial k) A).trans (polyEquivTensor k A).symm
47	
48	/-- Base change for the Laurent polynomial ring: `k[T;T⁻¹] ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]`. -/
49	noncomputable def laurentBaseChange (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
50	    (LaurentPolynomial k) ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A :=
51	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k (LaurentPolynomial k) A).trans
52	    (((AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv (M := ℤ) k A k).restrictScalars k).trans
53	      (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A)))
54	
55	/-- The final coefficient-change equivalence sends a `single` to a `single`. -/
56	private lemma mapAlgEquiv_single (n : ℤ) (x : A ⊗[k] k) :
57	    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv k ℤ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A))
58	        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n x)
59	      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k A x) := by
60	  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgEquiv_apply]; exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single _ _ _
61	
62	/-- `laurentBaseChange` on a monomial tensor `single n c ⊗ₜ 1`. -/
63	private lemma lbc_single (n : ℤ) (c : k) :
64	    laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n c ⊗ₜ 1)
65	      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (algebraMap k A c) := by
66	  simp only [laurentBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
67	    AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.tensorEquiv_tmul,
68	    map_one, one_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single, mapAlgEquiv_single,
69	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
70	    Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
71	
72	/-- On `x ⊗ₜ 1`, Laurent base change is the coefficient-change ring homomorphism induced
73	by `algebraMap k A`. -/
74	theorem laurentBaseChange_tmul_one (x : LaurentPolynomial k) :
75	    laurentBaseChange k A (x ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
76	      = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A) x := by
77	  have h : ((laurentBaseChange k A).toAlgHom.toRingHom.comp
78	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom))
79	      = (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)) := by
80	    apply AddMonoidAlgebra.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
81	    · intro r
82	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
83	      change laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 r ⊗ₜ 1) = _
84	      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
85	    · intro m
86	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
87	      change laurentBaseChange k A (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m 1 ⊗ₜ 1) = _
88	      rw [lbc_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
89	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x
90	
91	/-- Laurent base change fixes the constant `C c ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ C (algebraMap k A c)`. -/
92	theorem laurentBaseChange_C (c : k) :
93	    laurentBaseChange k A (LaurentPolynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1)
94	      = LaurentPolynomial.C (algebraMap k A c) := by
95	  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C, lbc_single, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]
96	
97	/-- Laurent base change fixes the generator `T n ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ T n`. -/
98	theorem laurentBaseChange_T (n : ℤ) :
99	    laurentBaseChange k A (LaurentPolynomial.T n ⊗ₜ 1) = LaurentPolynomial.T n := by
100	  rw [LaurentPolynomial.T, lbc_single, map_one, LaurentPolynomial.T]
101	
102	/-- `polyBaseChange` fixes the constant `C c ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ C (algebraMap k A c)`. -/
103	theorem polyBaseChange_C (c : k) :
104	    polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap k A c) := by
105	  simp only [polyBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
106	    polyEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul, -Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap,
107	    Polynomial.sum_C_index, one_mul, map_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left]
108	
109	/-- `polyBaseChange` fixes the generator `X ⊗ₜ 1 ↦ X`. -/
110	theorem polyBaseChange_X : polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.X ⊗ₜ 1) = Polynomial.X := by
111	  simp only [polyBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
112	    polyEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul]
113	  simp [Polynomial.X, Polynomial.sum_monomial_index]
114	
115	/-- On `p ⊗ₜ 1`, polynomial base change is `Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A)`. -/
116	theorem polyBaseChange_tmul_one (p : Polynomial k) :
117	    polyBaseChange k A (p ⊗ₜ[k] 1) = Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p := by
118	  have h : ((polyBaseChange k A).toAlgHom.toRingHom.comp
119	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom))
120	      = (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
121	    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
122	    · intro c
123	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
124	      change polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.C c ⊗ₜ 1) = _
125	      rw [polyBaseChange_C, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C]
126	    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_apply]
127	      change polyBaseChange k A (Polynomial.X ⊗ₜ 1) = _
128	      rw [polyBaseChange_X, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X]
129	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p
130	
131	/-- Naturality of the left chart map `Polynomial.toLaurent` under coefficient change. -/
132	theorem mapRingHom_toLaurent (p : Polynomial k) :
133	    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A) (Polynomial.toLaurent p)
134	      = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
135	  have h : (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)).comp
136	      (Polynomial.toLaurent (R := k))
137	      = (Polynomial.toLaurent (R := A)).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
138	    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
139	    · intro c
140	      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom,
141	        Polynomial.map_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
142	        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
143	    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_X, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom,
144	        Polynomial.map_X, LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
145	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p
146	
147	/-- Naturality of the right chart map `eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))` under coefficient change. -/
148	theorem mapRingHom_rightChart (p : Polynomial k) :
149	    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)
150	        (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) p)
151	      = Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
152	          (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
153	  have h : (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (M := ℤ) (algebraMap k A)).comp
154	      (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)))
155	      = (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := A)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))).comp
156	          (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
157	    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
158	    · intro c
159	      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C,
160	        Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
161	        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
162	    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_X,
163	        Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, LaurentPolynomial.T,
164	        AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one]
165	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h p
166	
167	/-- Left chart intertwining: base change commutes with `Polynomial.toLaurent`. -/
168	theorem laurentBaseChange_toLaurent (p : Polynomial k) :
169	    laurentBaseChange k A (Polynomial.toLaurent p ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
170	      = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
171	  rw [laurentBaseChange_tmul_one, mapRingHom_toLaurent]
172	
173	/-- Right chart intertwining: base change commutes with `eval₂RingHom C (T (-1))`. -/
174	theorem laurentBaseChange_rightChart (p : Polynomial k) :
175	    laurentBaseChange k A
176	        (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) p ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
177	      = Polynomial.eval₂RingHom LaurentPolynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
178	          (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) := by
179	  rw [laurentBaseChange_tmul_one, mapRingHom_rightChart]
180	
181	end AlgebraicGeometry
